maria: Heads-up: PR 842 (airgap installer docs) flagged by support — missing a KMS/HSM example and the network ports link is dead. Can someone take?
dave: I can handle the ports matrix. Which doc path?
maria: /docs/private/install/airgap.md under 'KMS integration' — placeholder text now. Link pointed at /docs/private/network/port-matrix.md (404).
sam_docs: I'll add a minimal PKCS#11 snippet and fix the link. Vendor-specific example or keep generic?
jin: Keep it vendor-neutral. Use an example from our CI test harness. Add security notes about PIN file perms and a systemd step to set ownership. Example:
```
# env example for PKCS11-backed KMS
PKCS11_MODULE=/opt/hsm/lib/libpkcs11.so
REDWOOD_KMS_PKCS11_URI=pkcs11:token=redwood;manufacturer=Acme
HSM_PIN_FILE=/etc/redwood/hsm-pin
```
dave: Call out networking: do NOT expose etcd/raft ports (2379/2380) publicly. For air-gapped installs include note about outbound SNAT for control-plane egress to STS endpoints and allowlist ranges for mirror sync.
maria: Also add a tiny port table (compact) and a troubleshooting anchor for cert chain issues — customers often forget to include intermediate CAs in the offline bundle.
sam_docs: Pushed commit 9f3b2a: fixed relative link to /docs/private/network/ports.md, added compact port table, added generic PKCS11 snippet, and systemd drop-in to chown/chmod PIN file: 
```
# /etc/systemd/system/redwood-kms.service.d/10-hsm-pin.conf
[Service]
Environment=HSM_PIN_FILE=/etc/redwood/hsm-pin
ExecStartPre=/bin/chown redwood:root /etc/redwood/hsm-pin
ExecStartPre=/bin/chmod 640 /etc/redwood/hsm-pin
```
Also added note: "Prefer key wrapping via KMS/HSM APIs; avoid storing unwrapped key material in app files."

jin: Can we add one sentence clarifying HSM vs cert-store to avoid confusion about storing keys in HSM slots vs using it for wrapping/cert operations?
maria: Yes please, and add a quick cert-chain snippet under troubleshooting for offline CA bundle assembly.
sam_docs: Added clarifying sentence and cert-chain troubleshooting anchor, addressed spellcheck. Ready for final review.
dave: LGTM from infra.
maria: Merging now.

sam_docs: Will watch staging and open a follow-up for the minor spell warning if it reappears.
